about: Enterprise ATT&CK's current techniques and sub-techniques, for a finding's ATT&CK field and the tag picker's technique box, made by scripts/attack_list.py from MITRE's STIX data. Each technique is [ID, name, tactic IDs]; a sub-technique's name is 'Technique: Sub-technique', as attack.mitre.org writes it. The tactics are in the matrix's order. 'revoked' maps each revoked ID to the current technique MITRE revoked it in favor of. Revoked and deprecated techniques aren't in the list.
